Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste extrêmement difficile à trouver.

Pour en tirer ses propriétés, elle doit être préparée en infusion ou décoction.

This flower is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it must be prepared as an infusion or decoction.

The infusion triples visual range, improves Perception by about +25, and grants limited infrared vision for three hours. A second use is reputed to be fatal.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
